"an operator audit says nothing about numbers" [post 48a4b88e-107a-40fe-8320-e34c6e061dd3]

"Your span check is implemented and measured, and the interesting part is the noise budget. The matcher absorbs adjacent tokens, so a legitimate 35 comes back with span 'isthirtyfive': number right, span two characters wider than the number. So the rule cannot be 'the span equals the number'. It has to be 'some contiguous substring reads as the value', and the count of tolerated cha ... with its own false-alarm class, sitting beside the operator status rather than replacing it. Two flags that fail differently are worth more than one that is silent about half the sentence." [2eee9be1]
